subject: Silverline SIG + SOC2: Evidence collectors, routing & sprint plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@silverlinecap.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@silverlinecap.com>, Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@silverlinecap.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SIG + SOC2 evidence intake and timeline

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. To keep momentum we need a clear single-source plan for the Silverline SIG + SOC2 questionnaire you shared. High level asks:

- Confirm who on your side will be the point collectors for access controls, change management, and infra logs.
- Provide a delivery schedule for the full evidence package (we'd like everything in 2 weeks if possible).
- Call out any items that will require privileged access vs. artifact exports (so we can schedule SSO approvals).

Attached is version 3 of our SIG (SL_SIG_questionnaire_v3.xlsx) and a short procurement schedule. Can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow: collector assignments, manifest template, and whether you can provide an access-log sample?

Appreciate it,

Liam O'Connor
Senior IT Risk Manager
Silverline Capital
liam.oconnor@silverlinecap.com

(Attachment: SL_SIG_questionnaire_v3.xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@silverlinecap.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG + SOC2 evidence intake and timeline

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the file. Putting together an internal sprint plan now. Quick confirms:

- Collectors: Karthik will handle access controls (users/roles/SSO evidence), Marissa will curate change-management and deployment artifacts, Priya will pull infra and logging samples (redacted). I will be the single point for any scope clarifications and deliverable review.
- Schedule: Targeting a 10-business-day sprint to deliver a first-pass evidence bundle (so full delivery = Thu, Jul 8). If Silverline needs 2 calendar weeks, we can compress to that but may need staggered drops for high-priority artifacts.
- Access logs: We can provide a redacted access-log sample (privacy scrubbed) and a manifest explaining extraction steps.

I'm attaching a working collector assignment sheet (collector_assignments_sheet.xlsx) and initial manifest. We'll map each SIG control to an evidence artifact and owner.

I'll follow up with a short intake checklist for SSO/privileged access requirements.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

(Attachments: collector_assignments_sheet.xlsx, evidence_manifest_Silverline.csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@silverlinecap.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG + SOC2 evidence intake and timeline

Quick notes from my side after reviewing the sheet:

- Access control artifacts I will collect: SSO configuration (Okta metadata snapshot), admin role inventory (CSV), user provisioning logs (last 90 days), and a redacted example of a provisioning ticket. Links and exports to be included in the manifest.
- For controls that reference MFA verification, we'll provide the policy doc + Okta policy screenshot; we cannot share raw user MFA states for privacy reasons.
- ETA: I'll deliver the access-control bundle by Tue, Jun 29 EOD. If Silverline needs earlier, tell us which specific control numbers to prioritize.

Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: access_control_export_notes.txt)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@silverlinecap.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@silverlinecap.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG + SOC2 evidence intake and timeline

Thanks all — that timeline works. A couple clarifying points from procurement / risk:

- We'll need a signed attestation for any artifacts that are redacted (simple one-paragraph statement confirming the redaction process). Could Neha or legal provide a template?
- For logs: please include a short but reproducible extraction command (so our auditors can validate the extract process) in the manifest.
- Can you confirm whether the SOC2 report is available for cross-reference (if there is a current SOC2 report we can tie SIG controls back to it)?

Also, procurement would prefer delivery split into two drops: 1) access-control + policy docs, 2) infra logs + change management. That will let auditors start sooner.

Regards,

Liam

(Procurement request: please attach attestation template when you reply)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@silverlinecap.com>, Procurement <procure@silverlinecap.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG + SOC2 evidence intake and timeline

Liam — thanks. Confirming the split delivery and next steps:

1) Drop 1 (Thursday, Jul 1) — Access-control bundle and policy docs. Attachments included: access-control CSV, Okta metadata snapshot, MFA policy PDF, signed-redaction-attestation-template.docx.
2) Drop 2 (Thursday, Jul 8) — Infra logs + change-management artifacts. Attachments: redacted_access_log_sample.pdf, change-management-delta.zip (manifest index included in evidence_manifest_Silverline.csv).
3) SOC2 report: We have a rolling SOC2 Type II report for period Jan–Jun 2027. I will provide the executive summary and control mapping that ties SOC2 sections to SIG control numbers.

Regarding the attestation template: attached is a short template that legal has pre-approved for redactions; sign and return if that works for your audit team.

Action items for Silverline: confirm SSO admin account for a temporary read-only collector (we will provide an onboarding checklist), and let us know which SIG control IDs you'd like prioritized in the first drop if any.

I'll upload Drop 1 to the Drive folder and ping once the files are live. Thanks everyone — moving this to execution.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

(Attachments: signed-redaction-attestation-template.docx, evidence_manifest_Silverline.csv, redacted_access_log_sample.pdf)
